readings.notes: These are repeated numbers already acquired for a different named maker. No source establishes KTS1606 andKinugawa405-99011-606 as the same supplied product. Application prints43169706735 rather than53169706735; preserve the typo and restrict direct993 evidence to the correctly printed6736 donor. Negative super-back−0.02mm also printed, not adopted as a machining clearance. Maximum boost marketing5bar/70psi is not a measured speed/flow or vehicle operating limit.

readings.locator: PDF p.2 XP5020–XP5023 table, VR Depths, Pin Length and Pin Wall columns
readings.finding: Flyer shows VR Depths .180/.135, Pin Length 2.250 and Pin Wall .160. Those three headers do not explicitly state a unit. Current manufacturer catalogue p84 marks these X-series products naturally aspirated; do not apply to M64/60.
readings.missing_evidence: Explicit primary dimensional-unit legend and exact Turbo product identity. No conversions accepted.

readings.finding: Primary FCP page adds another 127/58/23 mm rod product, FCPRHP1275823; no genuinely new high-resolution geometry was found. Marketing power/rpm claims not extracted as validated operating limits.
Maker describes inlet guide material without a grade or dimensions; no new dimensional record.
Titanium retainers described without numerical geometry, alloy grade or coating specification.
Earlier 993 and VarioRam examples do not establish Turbo application or explicit dimensional units in the inspected table.
